source.table: Table 5. Outlays of the U.S. Government, May 2026 and Other Periods
source.title: Department of Education section (Table-5 OVER-CAP sub-split, page 12), unit 1 of 2: the three bureaus that print a Total-- subtotal -- Office of Elementary and Secondary Education, Office of Postsecondary Education, and Office of Federal Student Aid. Each bureau's lines roll up into its own Total-- (self-contained). The sibling unit -education-departmental re-anchors these three bureau totals + the flat department lines to verify Total--Department of Education. Sizing: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md (Education 161 cells -> 2 units). Re-anchor pattern: the Table-4 receipts slices (-receipts-si-remainder).
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' (omitted). This is the first of two units splitting the over-cap Department of Education section; it holds only the three subtotal-bearing bureaus. Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Nine-column model: 3 periods x (Gross Outlays / Applicable Receipts / Outlays[net]). The Office of Postsecondary Education applicable column is entirely '(**)' (omitted). The Office of Federal Student Aid applicable column is single-source (only its 'Other' line carries a CFYTD applicable of 2), so the Total--Office of Federal Student Aid applicable cell (c5) is marked leaf and covered by the OFSA total-row net identity; the 'Other' line-level applicable is covered by its own net identity. Federal Student Loan Reserve Fund omits its This-Month cells; OFSA / Other omits This-Month (all '(**)') and its Prior-FYTD applicable. Non-default tolerances quote the Table-5 rounding note (p. 23): 'Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding.'
